headline: Base Turnover Resumes In Linn Of Mercy And Mooring County
war_summary: Base turnover has reignited along the central and northwestern fronts, with Linn of Mercy and Mooring County recording fresh strategic transitions over the past two hours after a brief operational lull. Linn of Mercy remains the war's bloodiest crucible, expending more than 3,700 men in the last two hours alone as fighting centers on Lathair and Outwich Ranch, while Mooring County registered renewed exchanges over The Wind Hills. Nevish Line and Weathered Expanse continue their protracted attritional churn, each logging ongoing frontline movements across Grief Mother, Blackcoat Way, Wightwalk, and Crow's Nest. In contrast, the rapid base trades recently reported across Stonecradle have cooled, with no strategic ownership shifts observed in the latest two-hour window despite lingering skirmishes. Sustained infantry pressure persists without immediate territorial change across Dead Lands, Marban Hollow, and Callahan's Passage, while the deeper rearward provinces remain entirely undisturbed.
